title: FIFA scraps plans to sell World Cup stakes to private equity following fierce backlash
summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino announced the abandonment of plans to sell World Cup stakes to private equity firms, citing a 'fierce backlash' from stakeholders. The move comes after widespread criticism and opposition from various football organizations, including UEFA. FIFA's ambitious $20 billion commercial venture has been abandoned. UEFA expressed a loss of confidence in the current FIFA leadership and its processes. Several football organizations criticized the lack of transparency behind the failed proposal.
